title: Still Water
scene: A commitment at the end of the night
together: The story closes that same night. The exhibition remains canceled, and their differences have not disappeared.
They choose a grounded commitment to each other and to learning how to communicate their needs. The exact final dialogue and action remain to be written.
aarna: She does not need to pretend the loss has stopped hurting in order to remain close to him.
Their commitment must leave room for her vulnerability rather than make endurance the price of being loved.
mukund: He does not become perfectly emotionally available overnight.
His commitment is to keep learning how to be present, not to promise that he can immediately fix every feeling or future setback.
